meta.topic: 三角恒等变换：和差角、二倍角、辅助角、反三角函数、正弦型模型、和差化积

zh:
先证余弦的差角公式。设单位圆上 $P(\cos\alpha,\sin\alpha)$、$Q(\cos\beta,\sin\beta)$，则弦长平方为
$$\begin{aligned}|PQ|^2&=(\cos\alpha-\cos\beta)^2+(\sin\alpha-\sin\beta)^2\\&=2-2(\cos\alpha\cos\beta+\sin\alpha\sin\beta).\end{aligned}$$
把 $P,Q$ 同时旋转 $-\beta$，$Q$ 落到 $(1,0)$，$P$ 落到 $(\cos(\alpha-\beta),\sin(\alpha-\beta))$；旋转保持距离，故
$$|PQ|^2=2-2\cos(\alpha-\beta).$$
两式相等得 $\cos(\alpha-\beta)=\cos\alpha\cos\beta+\sin\alpha\sin\beta$，对一切 $\alpha,\beta\in\mathbb R$ 成立。

在差角公式中把 $\beta$ 换成 $-\beta$，并用 $\cos(-\beta)=\cos\beta$、$\sin(-\beta)=-\sin\beta$，得
$$\cos(\alpha+\beta)=\cos\alpha\cos\beta-\sin\alpha\sin\beta.$$
两式对一切实数 $\alpha,\beta$ 成立，无需额外限制。

由诱导公式 $\sin\theta=\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)$，分别取 $\theta=\alpha+\beta$ 与 $\theta=\alpha-\beta$：
$$\begin{aligned}\sin(\alpha+\beta)&=\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha-\beta\right)=\cos\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha\right)-\beta\right)\\&=\sin\alpha\cos\beta+\cos\alpha\sin\beta,\end{aligned}$$
同理 $\sin(\alpha-\beta)=\sin\alpha\cos\beta-\cos\alpha\sin\beta$。合并写为 $\sin(\alpha\pm\beta)=\sin\alpha\cos\beta\pm\cos\alpha\sin\beta$。

正切由正弦与余弦之商得到：
$$ egin{aligned}	an(\alpha\pm eta)&= rac{\sin(\alpha\pm eta)}{\cos(\alpha\pm eta)}\&= rac{	an\alpha\pm	an eta}{1\mp	an\alpha	an eta},\end{aligned}$$
第二步是分子分母同除以 $\cos\alpha\cos eta$。成立条件为 $\cos\alpha\cos eta
e0$（保证 $	an\alpha,	an eta$ 有定义）且 $1\mp	an\alpha	an eta
e0$（保证分母不为零，等价于 $\cos(\alpha\pm eta)
e0$）。

令 $\beta=\alpha$，由和角公式得二倍角公式：
$$\sin2\alpha=2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha,\qquad \cos2\alpha=\cos^2\alpha-\sin^2\alpha.$$
再用 $\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1$ 消去一个平方，得到余弦的另外两种等价形式：
$$\cos2\alpha=2\cos^2\alpha-1=1-2\sin^2\alpha.$$
三式对一切实数 $\alpha$ 成立，选用哪一种取决于要保留 $\sin^2\alpha$ 还是 $\cos^2\alpha$。

把二倍角公式反解，得降幂公式：
$$\sin^2\alpha=\frac{1-\cos2\alpha}{2},\qquad \cos^2\alpha=\frac{1+\cos2\alpha}{2}.$$
将 $\alpha$ 换成 $\frac{\alpha}{2}$ 得半角公式；开方时必须按 $\frac{\alpha}{2}$ 所在象限取符号：
$$\begin{aligned}\sin\frac{\alpha}{2}&=\pm\sqrt{\frac{1-\cos\alpha}{2}},\\ \cos\frac{\alpha}{2}&=\pm\sqrt{\frac{1+\cos\alpha}{2}}.\end{aligned}$$
例如 $\sin15^\circ=\sin(45^\circ-30^\circ)=\frac{\sqrt6-\sqrt2}{4}$，可作为和差角公式的数值校验。
en:
First prove the cosine difference formula. On the unit circle take $P(\cos\alpha,\sin\alpha)$ and $Q(\cos\beta,\sin\beta)$. Then
$$\begin{aligned}|PQ|^2&=(\cos\alpha-\cos\beta)^2+(\sin\alpha-\sin\beta)^2\\&=2-2(\cos\alpha\cos\beta+\sin\alpha\sin\beta).\end{aligned}$$
Rotating both points by $-\beta$ sends $Q$ to $(1,0)$ and $P$ to $(\cos(\alpha-\beta),\sin(\alpha-\beta))$; rotation preserves distance, so
$$|PQ|^2=2-2\cos(\alpha-\beta).$$
Equating the two expressions gives $\cos(\alpha-\beta)=\cos\alpha\cos\beta+\sin\alpha\sin\beta$ for all $\alpha,\beta\in\mathbb R$.

Replace $\beta$ by $-\beta$ in the difference formula and use $\cos(-\beta)=\cos\beta$, $\sin(-\beta)=-\sin\beta$:
$$\cos(\alpha+\beta)=\cos\alpha\cos\beta-\sin\alpha\sin\beta.$$
Both formulas hold for all real $\alpha,\beta$ with no further restriction.

Using the reduction identity $\sin\theta=\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\theta\right)$ with $\theta=\alpha+\beta$ and $\theta=\alpha-\beta$:
$$\begin{aligned}\sin(\alpha+\beta)&=\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha-\beta\right)=\cos\left(\left(\frac{\pi}{2}-\alpha\right)-\beta\right)\\&=\sin\alpha\cos\beta+\cos\alpha\sin\beta,\end{aligned}$$
and similarly $\sin(\alpha-\beta)=\sin\alpha\cos\beta-\cos\alpha\sin\beta$. Hence $\sin(\alpha\pm\beta)=\sin\alpha\cos\beta\pm\cos\alpha\sin\beta$.

Tangent is the quotient of sine and cosine:
$$ egin{aligned}	an(\alpha\pm eta)&= rac{\sin(\alpha\pm eta)}{\cos(\alpha\pm eta)}\&= rac{	an\alpha\pm	an eta}{1\mp	an\alpha	an eta},\end{aligned}$$
where the second equality comes from dividing numerator and denominator by $\cos\alpha\cos eta$. The identity requires $\cos\alpha\cos eta
e0$ (so that $	an\alpha,	an eta$ are defined) and $1\mp	an\alpha	an eta
e0$ (so the denominator is nonzero, equivalently $\cos(\alpha\pm eta)
e0$).

Set $\beta=\alpha$ in the addition formulas to obtain the double-angle formulas:
$$\sin2\alpha=2\sin\alpha\cos\alpha,\qquad \cos2\alpha=\cos^2\alpha-\sin^2\alpha.$$
Eliminating one square via $\sin^2\alpha+\cos^2\alpha=1$ gives the other two equivalent forms:
$$\cos2\alpha=2\cos^2\alpha-1=1-2\sin^2\alpha.$$
All three hold for every real $\alpha$; the choice depends on whether $\sin^2\alpha$ or $\cos^2\alpha$ is to be kept.

Solving the double-angle formulas backwards gives the power-reduction formulas:
$$\sin^2\alpha=\frac{1-\cos2\alpha}{2},\qquad \cos^2\alpha=\frac{1+\cos2\alpha}{2}.$$
Replacing $\alpha$ by $\frac{\alpha}{2}$ yields the half-angle formulas; when taking square roots, the sign must follow the quadrant of $\frac{\alpha}{2}$:
$$\begin{aligned}\sin\frac{\alpha}{2}&=\pm\sqrt{\frac{1-\cos\alpha}{2}},\\ \cos\frac{\alpha}{2}&=\pm\sqrt{\frac{1+\cos\alpha}{2}}.\end{aligned}$$
For instance, $\sin15^\circ=\sin(45^\circ-30^\circ)=\frac{\sqrt6-\sqrt2}{4}$ provides a numerical check of the addition formula.

zh:
设 $a,b$ 不同时为零，$R=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}>0$。则
$$a\sin x+b\cos x=R\left(\frac{a}{R}\sin x+\frac{b}{R}\cos x\right),$$
且 $\left(\frac{a}{R}\right)^2+\left(\frac{b}{R}\right)^2=1$。因此存在角 $\varphi$（模 $2\pi$ 唯一），使
$$\cos\varphi=\frac{a}{R},\qquad \sin\varphi=\frac{b}{R}.$$
只写 $\tan\varphi=\frac{b}{a}$ 不能确定 $\varphi$：$\varphi$ 与 $\varphi+\pi$ 的正切相同，但会使 $\sin(x+\varphi)$ 整体变号。

反之，用和角公式展开：
$$R\sin(x+\varphi)=R(\sin x\cos\varphi+\cos x\sin\varphi)=a\sin x+b\cos x.$$
所以该式对一切 $x\in\mathbb R$ 恒成立；$R>0$ 就是合并后正弦波的振幅，$\varphi$ 是初相。$a,b$ 不同时为零保证 $R\ne0$，否则不能提取。

辅助角的象限由 $a,b$ 的符号决定，不能只看 $\arctan\frac ba$ 的主值：
- 若 $a>0$，取 $\varphi=\arctan\frac ba\in\left(-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right)$；
- 若 $a<0$，取 $\varphi=\arctan\frac ba+\pi$（模 $2\pi$）；
- 若 $a=0$，则 $b>0$ 时 $\varphi=\frac\pi2$，$b<0$ 时 $\varphi=-\frac\pi2$。

例如 $a=b=-1$ 时 $\frac ba=1$，但应取 $\varphi=\frac{5\pi}{4}$，而不是 $\frac\pi4$。

由 $|\sin(x+\varphi)|\le1$ 得值域
$$-\sqrt{a^2+b^2}\le a\sin x+b\cos x\le\sqrt{a^2+b^2}.$$
最大值在 $x+\varphi=\frac\pi2+2k\pi$ 取得，最小值在 $x+\varphi=-\frac\pi2+2k\pi$ 取得。又因为 $\sin$ 的最小正周期为 $2\pi$，所以原函数的最小正周期为 $2\pi$；若 $x$ 被限制在某个区间，还必须检查这些最值点是否落在区间内。

例：$f(x)=\sqrt3\sin x+\cos x$。这里 $a=\sqrt3>0$，$b=1$，$R=\sqrt{3+1}=2$，$\varphi=\arctan\frac{1}{\sqrt3}=\frac\pi6$，故
$$f(x)=2\sin\left(x+\frac\pi6\right).$$
展开可验证 $2\left(\sin x\cos\frac\pi6+\cos x\sin\frac\pi6\right)=\sqrt3\sin x+\cos x$。最大值为 $2$，在 $x=\frac\pi3+2k\pi$ 取得；最小值为 $-2$，在 $x=-\frac{2\pi}{3}+2k\pi$ 取得。

若只写 $\tan\varphi=\frac ba$ 而不看符号，会出错：$a=b=-1$ 时 $R=\sqrt2$，取 $\varphi=\frac\pi4$ 得 $\sqrt2\sin\left(x+\frac\pi4\right)=\sin x+\cos x$，与原式 $-\sin x-\cos x$ 相差一个负号；正确取 $\varphi=\frac{5\pi}{4}$，得 $\sqrt2\sin\left(x+\frac{5\pi}{4}\right)=-\sin x-\cos x$。另外，若改用满足 $\cos\theta=\frac bR$、$\sin\theta=\frac aR$ 的角 $\theta$（即 $\theta=\frac\pi2-\varphi$），则得余弦形式 $a\sin x+b\cos x=R\cos(x-\theta)$。
en:
Let $a,b$ not both be zero and set $R=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}>0$. Then
$$a\sin x+b\cos x=R\left(\frac{a}{R}\sin x+\frac{b}{R}\cos x\right),$$
and $\left(\frac{a}{R}\right)^2+\left(\frac{b}{R}\right)^2=1$. Hence there is an angle $\varphi$, unique modulo $2\pi$, such that
$$\cos\varphi=\frac{a}{R},\qquad \sin\varphi=\frac{b}{R}.$$
The single equation $\tan\varphi=\frac{b}{a}$ does not determine $\varphi$: $\varphi$ and $\varphi+\pi$ share the same tangent but make $\sin(x+\varphi)$ change sign overall.

Conversely, expand with the addition formula:
$$R\sin(x+\varphi)=R(\sin x\cos\varphi+\cos x\sin\varphi)=a\sin x+b\cos x.$$
Thus the identity holds for every $x\in\mathbb R$; $R>0$ is the amplitude of the resulting sine wave and $\varphi$ is its initial phase. The assumption that $a,b$ are not both zero ensures $R\ne0$, so the factoring is legitimate.

Since $|\sin(x+\varphi)|\le1$, the range is
$$-\sqrt{a^2+b^2}\le a\sin x+b\cos x\le\sqrt{a^2+b^2}.$$
The maximum occurs when $x+\varphi=\frac\pi2+2k\pi$ and the minimum when $x+\varphi=-\frac\pi2+2k\pi$. Because the least positive period of $\sin$ is $2\pi$, the least positive period of the original function is $2\pi$. If $x$ is restricted to an interval, one must still check whether these extremal points lie in it.

Example: $f(x)=\sqrt3\sin x+\cos x$. Here $a=\sqrt3>0$, $b=1$, $R=\sqrt{3+1}=2$ and $\varphi=\arctan\frac{1}{\sqrt3}=\frac\pi6$, so
$$f(x)=2\sin\left(x+\frac\pi6\right).$$
Expanding verifies $2\left(\sin x\cos\frac\pi6+\cos x\sin\frac\pi6\right)=\sqrt3\sin x+\cos x$. The maximum is $2$, attained at $x=\frac\pi3+2k\pi$; the minimum is $-2$, attained at $x=-\frac{2\pi}{3}+2k\pi$.

Using only $\tan\varphi=\frac ba$ without the signs can be wrong: for $a=b=-1$, $R=\sqrt2$, and $\varphi=\frac\pi4$ gives $\sqrt2\sin\left(x+\frac\pi4\right)=\sin x+\cos x$, which differs from the original $-\sin x-\cos x$ by an overall sign. The correct choice $\varphi=\frac{5\pi}{4}$ gives $\sqrt2\sin\left(x+\frac{5\pi}{4}\right)=-\sin x-\cos x$. Moreover, choosing an angle $\theta$ with $\cos\theta=\frac bR$ and $\sin\theta=\frac aR$ (that is, $\theta=\frac\pi2-\varphi$) yields the cosine form $a\sin x+b\cos x=R\cos(x-\theta)$.

zh:
$\sin$ 在 $\mathbb R$ 上以 $2\pi$ 为周期，不单调，因此没有全局反函数。把它限制到 $\left[-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right]$：在该区间上 $\sin$ 连续、严格递增（内部 $\cos x>0$），值从 $-1$ 增到 $1$，所以是从 $\left[-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right]$ 到 $[-1,1]$ 的双射。定义其反函数
$$y=\arcsin x\iff \sin y=x,\quad -1\le x\le1,\quad y\in\left[-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right].$$
定义域为 $[-1,1]$，值域为 $\left[-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right]$。

同理，$\cos$ 在 $[0,\pi]$ 上连续且严格递减（内部 $-\sin x<0$），值从 $1$ 降到 $-1$，故
$$y=\arccos x\iff \cos y=x,\quad -1\le x\le1,\quad y\in[0,\pi],$$
定义域为 $[-1,1]$，值域为 $[0,\pi]$。$\tan$ 在 $\left(-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right)$ 上严格递增（$\sec^2x>0$），且两端分别趋于 $\pm\infty$，值域为 $\mathbb R$，故
$$y=\arctan x\iff \tan y=x,\quad x\in\mathbb R,\quad y\in\left(-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right).$$
端点 $\pm\frac\pi2$ 不取，因为 $\tan$ 在那里无定义。

反函数的「抵消」只在规定区间内成立：
$$\sin(\arcsin x)=x\quad(-1\le x\le1),$$
但 $\arcsin(\sin x)$ 一般不等于 $x$，它等于区间 $\left[-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right]$ 内唯一满足 $\sin y=\sin x$ 的 $y$。例如 $\arcsin\left(\sin\frac{5\pi}{6}\right)=\arcsin\frac12=\frac\pi6$。类似地，$\arccos(\cos x)=x$ 仅当 $x\in[0,\pi]$，如 $\arccos\left(\cos\left(-\frac\pi3\right)\right)=\frac\pi3$；$\arctan(\tan x)=x$ 仅当 $x\in\left(-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right)$，如 $\arctan\left(\tan\frac{3\pi}{4}\right)=-\frac\pi4$。

恒等式 $\arcsin x+\arccos x=\frac\pi2$ 对 $x\in[-1,1]$ 成立。证明：令 $\theta=\arccos x\in[0,\pi]$，则 $\cos\theta=x$。令 $\eta=\frac\pi2-\theta$，则 $\eta\in\left[-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right]$ 且 $\sin\eta=\cos\theta=x$；由 $\arcsin$ 值的唯一性得 $\arcsin x=\eta$，故两角之和为 $\frac\pi2$。又因 $\cos(\pi-\theta)=-x$ 且 $\pi-\theta\in[0,\pi]$，得 $\arccos(-x)=\pi-\arccos x$；而 $\arcsin(-x)=-\arcsin x$、$\arctan(-x)=-\arctan x$ 来自相应的奇函数性。

求复合值时必须先定角的范围再定符号。设 $\theta=\arccos\frac35\in[0,\pi]$，则 $\cos\theta=\frac35$，且 $\sin\theta\ge0$，所以
$$\sin\left(\arccos\frac35\right)=\sqrt{1-\frac{9}{25}}=\frac45.$$
再如 $\phi=\arcsin\left(-\frac35\right)\in\left[-\frac\pi2,0\right]$，则 $\cos\phi=\frac45>0$，$\tan\phi=\frac{-3/5}{4/5}=-\frac34$。若忽略范围，开方时就会多出一个错误符号。

反三角函数的导数由反函数求导得到。对 $y=\arcsin x$，$x=\sin y$ 且 $y\in\left(-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right)$，故 $\cos y>0$，
$$\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{1}{\cos y}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^2}},\qquad |x|<1.$$
同理 $(\arccos x)'=-\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}$；对 $y=\arctan x$，$x=\tan y$，$\frac{dx}{dy}=\sec^2y=1+x^2$，故
$$(\arctan x)'=\frac{1}{1+x^2},\qquad x\in\mathbb R.$$
端点 $x=\pm1$ 处 $\arcsin$ 与 $\arccos$ 的导数不存在（函数图像有竖直切线）。
en:
The function $\sin$ has period $2\pi$ on $\mathbb R$ and is not monotone, so it has no global inverse. Restrict it to $\left[-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right]$: there $\sin$ is continuous and strictly increasing (with $\cos x>0$ in the interior), rising from $-1$ to $1$, so it is a bijection from $\left[-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right]$ onto $[-1,1]$. Its inverse is
$$y=\arcsin x\iff \sin y=x,\quad -1\le x\le1,\quad y\in\left[-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right].$$
The domain is $[-1,1]$ and the range is $\left[-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right]$.

Similarly, $\cos$ is continuous and strictly decreasing on $[0,\pi]$ (with $-\sin x<0$ in the interior), falling from $1$ to $-1$, hence
$$y=\arccos x\iff \cos y=x,\quad -1\le x\le1,\quad y\in[0,\pi],$$
with domain $[-1,1]$ and range $[0,\pi]$. The function $\tan$ is strictly increasing on $\left(-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right)$ (since $\sec^2x>0$) and tends to $\pm\infty$ at the two ends, so its range is $\mathbb R$ and
$$y=\arctan x\iff \tan y=x,\quad x\in\mathbb R,\quad y\in\left(-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right).$$
The endpoints $\pm\frac\pi2$ are excluded because $\tan$ is undefined there.

The inverse-function cancellation laws hold only on the prescribed intervals:
$$\sin(\arcsin x)=x\quad(-1\le x\le1),$$
but $\arcsin(\sin x)$ is generally not $x$; it is the unique $y\in\left[-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right]$ with $\sin y=\sin x$. For example, $\arcsin\left(\sin\frac{5\pi}{6}\right)=\arcsin\frac12=\frac\pi6$. Likewise, $\arccos(\cos x)=x$ only for $x\in[0,\pi]$, e.g. $\arccos\left(\cos\left(-\frac\pi3\right)\right)=\frac\pi3$; and $\arctan(\tan x)=x$ only for $x\in\left(-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right)$, e.g. $\arctan\left(\tan\frac{3\pi}{4}\right)=-\frac\pi4$.

The identity $\arcsin x+\arccos x=\frac\pi2$ holds for $x\in[-1,1]$. Proof: let $\theta=\arccos x\in[0,\pi]$, so $\cos\theta=x$. Put $\eta=\frac\pi2-\theta$; then $\eta\in\left[-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right]$ and $\sin\eta=\cos\theta=x$. By uniqueness of the arcsine value, $\arcsin x=\eta$, so the two angles sum to $\frac\pi2$. Since $\cos(\pi-\theta)=-x$ and $\pi-\theta\in[0,\pi]$, we also get $\arccos(-x)=\pi-\arccos x$; the relations $\arcsin(-x)=-\arcsin x$ and $\arctan(-x)=-\arctan x$ follow from the corresponding oddness.

When evaluating composite expressions, determine the angle range first and then the sign. Let $\theta=\arccos\frac35\in[0,\pi]$; then $\cos\theta=\frac35$ and $\sin\theta\ge0$, so
$$\sin\left(\arccos\frac35\right)=\sqrt{1-\frac{9}{25}}=\frac45.$$
Also let $\phi=\arcsin\left(-\frac35\right)\in\left[-\frac\pi2,0\right]$; then $\cos\phi=\frac45>0$ and $\tan\phi=\frac{-3/5}{4/5}=-\frac34$. Ignoring the range would introduce a spurious sign when taking the square root.

The derivatives of the inverse trigonometric functions follow from inverse-function differentiation. For $y=\arcsin x$, $x=\sin y$ with $y\in\left(-\frac\pi2,\frac\pi2\right)$, so $\cos y>0$ and
$$\frac{dy}{dx}=\frac{1}{\cos y}=\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^2}},\qquad |x|<1.$$
Similarly $(\arccos x)'=-\frac{1}{\sqrt{1-x^2}}$. For $y=\arctan x$, $x=\tan y$ and $\frac{dx}{dy}=\sec^2y=1+x^2$, hence
$$(\arctan x)'=\frac{1}{1+x^2},\qquad x\in\mathbb R.$$
At the endpoints $x=\pm1$, the derivatives of $\arcsin$ and $\arccos$ do not exist (the graph has a vertical tangent).

zh:
正弦型函数的一般形式为
$$y=A\sin(\omega x+\varphi)+k,\qquad A\ne0,\ \omega\ne0.$$
通常取 $A>0,\omega>0$。因为 $\sin$ 的值域是 $[-1,1]$，所以
$$k-|A|\le y\le k+|A|,$$
振幅为 $|A|$，平衡位置为 $y=k$。若 $T>0$ 是周期，则对一切 $x$ 有 $\sin(\omega(x+T)+\varphi)=\sin(\omega x+\varphi)$，即 $\omega T=2n\pi$；最小正周期为 $T=\frac{2\pi}{|\omega|}$。

若已知模型在一个周期内的最大值 $M$ 与最小值 $m$，则
$$M=k+|A|,\qquad m=k-|A|,$$
解得
$$|A|=\frac{M-m}{2},\qquad k=\frac{M+m}{2}.$$
这里要求 $M,m$ 确实被取到；若数据只给出局部观测，必须先确认它覆盖了一个完整的极值周期。若约定 $A>0$，则 $A=|A|$；若 $A<0$，可把负号并入相位：$A\sin\theta=|A|\sin(\theta+\pi)$。

周期也可由图像读出：相邻两个最高点（或相邻两个最低点）的横坐标之差为 $T$；相邻的最高点与最低点之差为 $\frac T2$；当纵向平移 $k=0$ 时，相邻两个变号零点的间距为 $\frac T2$；$k\ne0$ 时一般不等于 $\frac T2$，应由最高/最低点定周期。因此
$$\omega=\frac{2\pi}{T}.$$
若按习惯取 $\omega>0$，而读出的是负值，则用 $|\omega|$ 代替 $\omega$，并用 $\pi-\varphi$ 代替 $\varphi$，以保持函数不变。

初相由图像上的一个已知点确定。以 $A>0,\omega>0$ 为例：
- 若在 $x_0$ 处图像从平衡位置上升，则 $\omega x_0+\varphi=2k\pi$；
- 若在 $x_0$ 处取最大值，则 $\omega x_0+\varphi=\frac\pi2+2k\pi$；
- 若在 $x_0$ 处取最小值，则 $\omega x_0+\varphi=-\frac\pi2+2k\pi$。

解出 $\varphi=-\omega x_0+c$，其中 $c$ 为上述相位值。$\varphi$ 并不唯一，相差 $2\pi$ 给出同一函数；通常取 $\varphi\in(-\pi,\pi]$。图像的左右平移量为 $h=-\frac{\varphi}{\omega}$，即 $y=A\sin(\omega(x-h))+k$。

例：某地气温近似为
$$T(t)=10+8\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{12}t-\frac{\pi}{2}\right),$$
$t$ 以小时计，$T$ 以摄氏度计。对照一般式，$A=8$，$\omega=\frac{\pi}{12}$，$\varphi=-\frac{\pi}{2}$，$k=10$。最高气温 $k+A=18^\circ\text{C}$，最低气温 $k-A=2^\circ\text{C}$，周期 $T=\frac{2\pi}{\pi/12}=24$ 小时。$t=0$ 时 $\sin\left(-\frac\pi2\right)=-1$，取到最低温；$t=12$ 时取到最高温，与昼夜节律一致。

建立正弦型模型时要注意适用范围：模型假设振幅、周期、平衡位置在整个考察区间内不变；由有限数据拟合后，应检查残差与周期性，不能把局部近似外推为无限期的预测。参数还有约定与等价性：振幅是非负的 $|A|$，$\omega$ 的符号可吸收进相位，$\varphi$ 只在模 $2\pi$ 意义下唯一；时间的单位必须与 $\omega$ 的单位匹配（$t$ 用小时而 $\omega$ 用 rad/h 时，$2\pi$ 对应一个周期）。此外，同频正弦型函数相加仍是正弦型函数，可用辅助角公式合并。
en:
The general sinusoidal function is
$$y=A\sin(\omega x+\varphi)+k,\qquad A\ne0,\ \omega\ne0.$$
Usually one takes $A>0$ and $\omega>0$. Since the range of $\sin$ is $[-1,1]$,
$$k-|A|\le y\le k+|A|,$$
so the amplitude is $|A|$ and the equilibrium level is $y=k$. If $T>0$ is a period, then $\sin(\omega(x+T)+\varphi)=\sin(\omega x+\varphi)$ for all $x$, which forces $\omega T=2n\pi$; the least positive period is $T=\frac{2\pi}{|\omega|}$.

If the maximum $M$ and minimum $m$ over one period are known, then
$$M=k+|A|,\qquad m=k-|A|,$$
and hence
$$|A|=\frac{M-m}{2},\qquad k=\frac{M+m}{2}.$$
This requires that $M$ and $m$ are actually attained; if the data are only local observations, one must first confirm that they cover a full period of extrema. Under the convention $A>0$, $A=|A|$; if $A<0$, absorb the sign into the phase: $A\sin\theta=|A|\sin(\theta+\pi)$.

The period can also be read from the graph: the horizontal distance between two consecutive maxima (or two consecutive minima) is $T$; that between a maximum and the adjacent minimum is $\frac T2$; and, when the vertical shift is $k=0$, that between two consecutive sign-changing zeros is $\frac T2$; for $k\ne0$ it is generally not $\frac T2$, so use consecutive maxima/minima to determine the period. Therefore
$$\omega=\frac{2\pi}{T}.$$
If the convention $\omega>0$ is desired but the read-off value is negative, replace $\omega$ by $|\omega|$ and $\varphi$ by $\pi-\varphi$ to keep the function unchanged.

Example: a local temperature is modelled by
$$T(t)=10+8\sin\left(\frac{\pi}{12}t-\frac{\pi}{2}\right),$$
with $t$ in hours and $T$ in degrees Celsius. Comparing with the general form, $A=8$, $\omega=\frac{\pi}{12}$, $\varphi=-\frac{\pi}{2}$ and $k=10$. The maximum is $k+A=18^\circ\text{C}$, the minimum is $k-A=2^\circ\text{C}$, and the period is $T=\frac{2\pi}{\pi/12}=24$ hours. At $t=0$, $\sin\left(-\frac\pi2\right)=-1$ gives the minimum; at $t=12$ the maximum occurs, matching the daily cycle.

When building a sinusoidal model, keep its scope in mind: it assumes that amplitude, period and equilibrium level stay constant over the whole interval of interest. After fitting finite data, check the residuals and the periodicity; do not extrapolate a local approximation into an indefinite forecast. There are also conventions and equivalences: the amplitude is the nonnegative $|A|$, the sign of $\omega$ can be absorbed into the phase, and $\varphi$ is unique only modulo $2\pi$. The time unit must match that of $\omega$ (if $t$ is in hours and $\omega$ in rad/h, then $2\pi$ corresponds to one period). Finally, a sum of same-frequency sinusoids is again sinusoidal and can be merged by the auxiliary-angle formula.

zh:
从四个和差角公式出发：
$$\begin{aligned}\sin(\alpha+\beta)&=\sin\alpha\cos\beta+\cos\alpha\sin\beta,\\\sin(\alpha-\beta)&=\sin\alpha\cos\beta-\cos\alpha\sin\beta.\end{aligned}$$
两式相加得
$$\sin(\alpha+\beta)+\sin(\alpha-\beta)=2\sin\alpha\cos\beta,$$
即 $\sin\alpha\cos\beta=\frac12[\sin(\alpha+\beta)+\sin(\alpha-\beta)]$。这就是积化和差的第一式；两式相减则得到 $\cos\alpha\sin\beta$ 的公式。

对余弦的两个和差角公式作同样的相加、相减，得到另外两式：
$$\begin{aligned}\cos\alpha\cos\beta&=\frac12[\cos(\alpha+\beta)+\cos(\alpha-\beta)],\\ \sin\alpha\sin\beta&=\frac12[\cos(\alpha-\beta)-\cos(\alpha+\beta)].\end{aligned}$$
连同
$$\cos\alpha\sin\beta=\frac12[\sin(\alpha+\beta)-\sin(\alpha-\beta)],$$
四式合称积化和差。它们对一切实数 $\alpha,\beta$ 成立，注意 $\sin\alpha\sin\beta$ 的括号内是「差减和」，不要写反。

反过来，令
$$u=\alpha+\beta,\qquad v=\alpha-\beta,$$
则
$$\alpha=\frac{u+v}{2},\qquad \beta=\frac{u-v}{2}.$$
把 $\sin u+\sin v=2\sin\alpha\cos\beta$ 中的 $\alpha,\beta$ 换回 $u,v$，得
$$\sin u+\sin v=2\sin\frac{u+v}{2}\cos\frac{u-v}{2}.$$
再将记号 $u,v$ 改回 $\alpha,\beta$：
$$\sin\alpha+\sin\beta=2\sin\frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}\cos\frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}.$$
这就是和差化积的正弦和公式。

在正弦和公式中把 $\beta$ 换成 $-\beta$，利用 $\sin(-\beta)=-\sin\beta$、$\cos(-\beta)=\cos\beta$，得
$$\sin\alpha-\sin\beta=2\cos\frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}\sin\frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}.$$
对余弦和、余弦差作同样处理：
$$\begin{aligned}\cos\alpha+\cos\beta&=2\cos\frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}\cos\frac{\alpha-\beta}{2},\\ \cos\alpha-\cos\beta&=-2\sin\frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}\sin\frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}.\end{aligned}$$
最后一式的负号来自 $\cos(\alpha+\beta)-\cos(\alpha-\beta)=-2\sin\alpha\sin\beta$，不能遗漏。

例：化简 $\sin40^\circ+\sin20^\circ$。由和差化积，
$$\begin{aligned}\sin40^\circ+\sin20^\circ&=2\sin\frac{40^\circ+20^\circ}{2}\cos\frac{40^\circ-20^\circ}{2}\\&=2\sin30^\circ\cos10^\circ=\cos10^\circ.\end{aligned}$$
数值校验：$\cos10^\circ\approx0.9848$，而 $\sin40^\circ+\sin20^\circ\approx0.6428+0.3420=0.9848$，两者一致。这里所有角都用度，半和、半差仍是度，不能与弧度混用。

两族公式的用途不同：积化和差把乘积拆成和差，便于逐项积分或求和；和差化积把和差压成乘积，便于解方程和判断零点。例如
$$\sin5x\cos3x=\frac12(\sin8x+\sin2x),$$
故 $\int\sin5x\cos3x\,dx=-\frac{1}{16}\cos8x-\frac14\cos2x+C$。又如
$$\cos3x-\cos x=-2\sin2x\sin x=0$$
给出 $\sin2x=0$ 或 $\sin x=0$，即 $x=\frac{k\pi}{2}$。使用时要检查是否除以了可能为零的因子，以免漏解或增解。
en:
Start from the four addition and subtraction formulas:
$$\begin{aligned}\sin(\alpha+\beta)&=\sin\alpha\cos\beta+\cos\alpha\sin\beta,\\\sin(\alpha-\beta)&=\sin\alpha\cos\beta-\cos\alpha\sin\beta.\end{aligned}$$
Adding them gives
$$\sin(\alpha+\beta)+\sin(\alpha-\beta)=2\sin\alpha\cos\beta,$$
that is, $\sin\alpha\cos\beta=\frac12[\sin(\alpha+\beta)+\sin(\alpha-\beta)]$. This is the first product-to-sum formula; subtracting the two formulas gives the one for $\cos\alpha\sin\beta$.

Applying the same addition and subtraction to the two cosine formulas yields the other two:
$$\begin{aligned}\cos\alpha\cos\beta&=\frac12[\cos(\alpha+\beta)+\cos(\alpha-\beta)],\\ \sin\alpha\sin\beta&=\frac12[\cos(\alpha-\beta)-\cos(\alpha+\beta)].\end{aligned}$$
Together with
$$\cos\alpha\sin\beta=\frac12[\sin(\alpha+\beta)-\sin(\alpha-\beta)],$$
these four are the product-to-sum formulas. They hold for all real $\alpha,\beta$; note that the bracket for $\sin\alpha\sin\beta$ is «difference minus sum», not the reverse.

Conversely, set
$$u=\alpha+\beta,\qquad v=\alpha-\beta.$$
Then
$$\alpha=\frac{u+v}{2},\qquad \beta=\frac{u-v}{2}.$$
Replacing $\alpha,\beta$ in $\sin u+\sin v=2\sin\alpha\cos\beta$ by these expressions gives
$$\sin u+\sin v=2\sin\frac{u+v}{2}\cos\frac{u-v}{2}.$$
Renaming $u,v$ back to $\alpha,\beta$,
$$\sin\alpha+\sin\beta=2\sin\frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}\cos\frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}.$$
This is the sine sum-to-product formula.

Replace $\beta$ by $-\beta$ in the sine-sum formula and use $\sin(-\beta)=-\sin\beta$, $\cos(-\beta)=\cos\beta$:
$$\sin\alpha-\sin\beta=2\cos\frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}\sin\frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}.$$
Treating the cosine sum and difference similarly gives
$$\begin{aligned}\cos\alpha+\cos\beta&=2\cos\frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}\cos\frac{\alpha-\beta}{2},\\ \cos\alpha-\cos\beta&=-2\sin\frac{\alpha+\beta}{2}\sin\frac{\alpha-\beta}{2}.\end{aligned}$$
The minus sign in the last formula comes from $\cos(\alpha+\beta)-\cos(\alpha-\beta)=-2\sin\alpha\sin\beta$ and must not be dropped.

Example: simplify $\sin40^\circ+\sin20^\circ$. By sum-to-product,
$$\begin{aligned}\sin40^\circ+\sin20^\circ&=2\sin\frac{40^\circ+20^\circ}{2}\cos\frac{40^\circ-20^\circ}{2}\\&=2\sin30^\circ\cos10^\circ=\cos10^\circ.\end{aligned}$$
Numerical check: $\cos10^\circ\approx0.9848$, while $\sin40^\circ+\sin20^\circ\approx0.6428+0.3420=0.9848$, in agreement. All angles here are in degrees; the half-sum and half-difference remain in degrees, so degrees and radians must not be mixed.

The two families serve different purposes: product-to-sum splits a product into sums, which is convenient for term-by-term integration or summation; sum-to-product compresses a sum into a product, which is convenient for solving equations and locating zeros. For example,
$$\sin5x\cos3x=\frac12(\sin8x+\sin2x),$$
so $\int\sin5x\cos3x\,dx=-\frac{1}{16}\cos8x-\frac14\cos2x+C$. Also,
$$\cos3x-\cos x=-2\sin2x\sin x=0$$
gives $\sin2x=0$ or $\sin x=0$, hence $x=\frac{k\pi}{2}$. When using these identities, check whether you have divided by a factor that may vanish, so as not to lose or add solutions.
